article.title: Toronto plays conference rival Orlando
article.story: Orlando Magic (1-2, 10th in the Eastern Conference) vs. Toronto Raptors (2-1, fourth in the Eastern Conference) Toronto; Wednesday, 7:30 p.m. EDT BOTTOM LINE: Toronto takes on Orlando in a matchup of Eastern Conference teams. Toronto went 46-36 overall and 33-19 in Eastern Conference games a season ago. The Raptors allowed opponents to score 111.8 points per game and shoot 46.7% from the field last season. Orlando went 45-37 overall and 26-26 in Eastern Conference games during the 2025-26 season. The Magic averaged 115.7 points per game while allowing opponents to score 115.1 last season. INJURIES: Raptors: Kawhi Leonard: day to day (knee), Nate Bittle: day to day (foot). Magic: Paolo Banchero: out (ankle), Jonathan Isaac: day to day (knee), Izaiyah Nelson: out (ankle), Noah Penda: out (hamstring), Jalen Suggs: out (knee). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
